item.name: How to use sports betting API
Get Started
item.description:
- Receive an API Key from the game provider.
    
- One agent can only support one currency type.
    
- Requests the API provider to set a callback URL and callback token.

item.name: API Workflow
item.description:
API URL: [https://{{BaseUrl}}/sportsAPI](https://sportsbook.needforspeedau.com/sportsAPI)

### HTTP Headers Required for API and Callback

All HTTP requests related to using the API and Callback must include the following HTTP headers.

---

| Name | Value | Example |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Authorization` | `Bearer {API TOKEN}` | `Authorization: Bearer ed45553e-1702-4342-a70d-09bf7ff7f568` |
| `Accept` | `application/json` | `Accept: application/json` |
| `Content-Type` | `application/json` | `Content-Type: application/json` |

### Seamless

1. Create a user
    
2. Get a game url.
    
3. Get balance using callback.
    
4. Bet using callback
    
5. Win(win, loss,cashout, refund) using callback
    

##Token Info##

When you send create user and get game url request, you have to use token(API token) issued by the provider as the request header token.  
And you can check header token(CallBack token) issued by provider when you receive callback request.

item.name: API & Callback Response Codes
item.description:
This is the response code when calling the API and Callback.

| Message | Code | Explanation |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `OK` | `0` | `Success` |
| `Failed` | `1001` | `Authentication token not found` |
| `Failed` | `1002` | `Username not found` |
| `Failed` | 1003 | Usercode not found |
| Failed | 9999 | Unknown Error |

The sports API can only be used in iframe format.

For users who are not logged in, you can display it via iframe using [https://BaseApiLink/lang](https://BaseApiLink).

Please contact the provider about BaseApiLink.

Create user information and return user information. The user name must be unique, and if a user is created with the same name, the existing user information is returned. The returned `user_code` value is used to identify the user when requesting user-related APIs.**.** **\[Required Header\]** | **Name** | Value | Example | | --- | --- | --- | | Authorization | Bearer {SPORTS_API_TOKEN} | Authorization: Bearer 149eb004-68bc-4ddb-a5e1-42c491d9569a | | Content-Type | application/json | Content-Type: application/json | ## **Request** | PARAMETER | DESCRIPTION | FORMAT | EXAMPLE | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | "name" | an user's name
maxLength: 50

pattern: ^\[_a-zA-Z0-9\]+$ | string | "test" | ## **Response** | PARAMETER | DESCRIPTION | FORMAT | EXAMPLE | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | "code" | Result codes 0, 1001.. (See Result Codes) | integer($int32) | 0 | | "message" | Description of the result. | string | OK | | "data" | {

"name": user name,
"balance"
} | {
